lyrics:
[verse]
Bruno held his cookie tight,
Waiting for the rain all night!
Kiki said, you silly pup,
It means you save some good things up!
[chorus]
Save it for a rainy day, save it for a rainy day,
Keep a little, put it away!
Save it for a rainy day, save it for a rainy day,
Someday you'll be glad, hooray!
[verse]
It means you save for later on,
So when you need it, it's not gone,
Coins or snacks, you keep a few,
For a day when you'll need them too!
[chorus]
Save it for a rainy day, save it for a rainy day,
Keep a little, put it away!
Save it for a rainy day, save it for a rainy day,
Tuck it in your piggy bank, okay!
[outro]
So keep a little tucked away,
Save it for a rainy day!
